questions.question: When tax collectors and sinners gathered to listen to Jesus, what complaint did the Pharisees and scribes make about Him?

answers.text: He welcomes sinners and eats with them
He heals people on the Sabbath day
He doesn't wash before He eats

questions.question: In Jesus' parable, a man has a hundred sheep and one gets lost. What does the man do?

answers.text: Leaves the ninety-nine and goes after it
Stays put and guards the ninety-nine
Sends a servant out to look for it

questions.question: Jesus said there is more joy in heaven over ninety-nine righteous people than over one sinner who repents. True or false?
In Jesus' parable, a woman loses one of her ten silver coins. How does she look for it?

answers.text: Lights a lamp and sweeps her house
Asks her neighbors to help her look
Waits for it to turn up on its own
